items.title: Sony unveils world’s 1st Eclipsa Audio-certified mic for smartphones
items.summary: Sony has unveiled the ECM-AX10 microphone, the world’s first Eclipsa Audio-certified microphone for smartphones. Tailored for vloggers, content creators, and even smartphone filmmakers, the ECM-AX10 helps capture video sound that feels more natural, immersive, and true to the mom
